scope: Local race-enabled actual executable, current ordinary IAM/KMS and native PostgreSQL; not native AWS crawler parity

failures_fixed.diagnosis: JDBC GetConnection authorization used the outer context from inside the SQLite view, so IAM could not join the reader transaction. Crawler remained RUNNING and CLI polling failed. Fixed by authorizing with Reader.Context().
KMS Decrypt returned a typed nil *awswire.Error assigned into an existing error interface. Successful plaintext projection falsely returned an error. Use a distinct typed rejected variable.
